profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: As a Software Engineer at itopia, I contribute to pioneering innovations for the future of work and learning. My role focuses on defining and maintaining source code for key software components, ensuring their functionality and integrity. My commitment to operational feasibility, documentation, and solution development in a SCRUM environment reflects my dedication to professional excellence.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed responsive and accessible user interfaces using Angular and TypeScript, enhancing user engagement. Styled components with Tailwind CSS, ensuring clean, consistent design across multiple applications. Engineered and implemented reusable UI components, accelerating development cycles and improving code maintainability. Integrated gRPC services into Angular applications for efficient, high-performance communication with back-end microservices. Applied unit testing using Jest, achieving and maintaining 90%+ frontend code coverage. Led UI/UX enhancements based on user feedback and A/B testing, resulting in a 25% reduction in bounce rates and increased user satisfaction. Collaborated closely with UX/UI designers to translate Figma mockups into pixel-perfect, interactive Angular components. Utilized reactive programming principles with RxJS for managing complex asynchronous data flows and state. Improved application accessibility to meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards, expanding usability for diverse user groups. Actively participated in peer code reviews, championing code quality, consistency, and adherence to best practices. Diagnosed and resolved cross-browser compatibility issues, ensuring a seamless experience across all major browsers. Contributed to Agile/SCRUM ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and demos.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description: Built and maintained scalable, high-availability backend services using .NET Core and C#, supporting more than 2000 concurrent users. Designed and implemented GraphQL APIs, providing flexible and efficient data querying capabilities for frontend clients and reducing data over-fetching. Managed and optimized both relational and non-relational databases, including BigQuery for analytics and Firestore for scalable document storage. Developed robust backend modules for user authentication, authorization, and session management, enhancing application security. Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests to ensure code reliability and maintainability, increasing test coverage from 10% to 90%. Created cloud functions and services using Google Cloud Platform, including Firestore and Pub/Sub. Collaborated with cloud engineers to deploy and monitor services on GCP, establishing effective logging and alerting strategies for high uptime. Investigated and resolved system performance bottlenecks, achieving a 35% improvement in average API response times. Created and maintained detailed documentation for backend architecture and GraphQL schema for internal teams and external partners. Integrated secure data validation and sanitization mechanisms throughout the application to prevent common vulnerabilities like XSS and SQL injection. Supported frontend development teams by providing well-structured GraphQL endpoints and clear data contracts.

positions.description:
○ Key responsibilities include defining and maintaining source code for crucial software components.
○ Ensure integrity and functionality of implementation subsystems throughout development.
○ Conduct unit testing to maintain code reliability and follow SCRUM methodology in software development lifecycle.
○ Involved in system analysis, operational feasibility evaluation, and solution development.
○ Document solutions effectively using various methods, including flowcharts, layouts, and clear code.
○ Participate in improving operations by recommending changes in policies and procedures.
